name: Brominated Vegetable Oil
aliases: brominated vegetable oil, BVO, brominated soybean oil, brominated soy bean oil, brominated oil
what_is: A brominated oil formerly used in some beverages to keep citrus-flavour oils dispersed and stable.
why_botia: BOTIA flags an explicit BVO declaration because regulatory status differs by market and time. The FDA revoked the U.S. regulation authorising BVO in food, with the compliance date in 2025. An explicit term may still occur on legacy or non-U.S. labels; a regulatory prohibition is not, by itself, a measurement of harm from a particular product.
can_1: Detect brominated vegetable oil, BVO and explicitly named brominated oils when they are printed in the ingredient list.
can_2: Explain the current U.S. regulatory status and the historical technological use without extrapolating it to every jurisdiction.
cannot_1: Determine whether an unlabeled product contains BVO.
cannot_2: Infer the amount present, past exposure or an individual health effect from the ingredient name alone.

sources.label: FDA — revocation of the regulation allowing BVO in food
